title: Dillon

{{NPC Infobox |image = .png |type = Open-World/Event |nation = Rinascita |location = Riccioli Islands |group = |affiliation = |title = }} '''Dillon''' is a male NPC found by the broken ship, Pequod, at the Port of Riccioli in [[Riccioli Islands]].
His dialogue changes throughout the progression of [[Old Man and the Whale]] Interlude Quest. ==Quests and Events== {{Quests and Events}} ==Dialogue== {{Dialogue Start}} ;(Help fix the Pequod for the first time) :;'''Dillon''' That weird guy hasn't noticed us yet, right? :;'''Dillon''' Ah, I'm sure this ship would be magnificent when it's all fixed-up. :;'''Dillon''' Too bad it's haunted. :'''Dillon''': Are you curious about this old ship too? Hmm, seems like I'm not the only one who thinks there's something wrong with it. :'''Dillon''': See, we've always fished close to shore, that's why we Riccioli fishermen use Gondolas when we head out. :'''Dillon''': But word is, years ago Captain Ahab and his crew pulled out a wreck of a ship outta the sea, then left it with a strange fella to guard it. :{{DIcon}} That's not so strange, is it? :'''Dillon''': You think that's it? Now, don't go getting all scared on me... This ship... it's a ''ghost''ship! :{{DIcon}} Come again? :'''Dillon''': There's a fella, Queequeg's his name, who's always mumbling something to the ship. And the damn wreck... it answers him! Mentions a "Flash" an awful lot... :'''Dillon''': Eh, enough of this! I'm not saying a word more. Get going, quick! :'''Dillon''': Otherwise, that crazy ol' bastard is gonna be back any minute, mark my words! ---- ;(Help fix the Pequod for a second time) :;'''Dillon''' What in the world? How did this ship get fixed up all of a sudden?! :;'''Dillon''' It's gotta be haunted! There's no other explanation! :;'''Dillon''' Impossible. That's not possible! I've been keeping my eyes on it for days! :;'''Dillon''' How could it get fixed so fast? :'''Dillon''': Strange... So strange! :{{DIcon}} Got something else to make a fuss about? :'''Dillon''': My old man used to tell me that Queequeg had been working on this ship for years, fixin' it up with nary a single change! :'''Dillon''': Now, all of a sudden, the mast is fixed and soon the canvas will be patched up too! :{{DIcon}} I helped him with the repairs! :{{DIcon}} That's all thanks to me. :'''Dillon''': Oh, it was you? Well, that's bit odd, isn't it? :'''Dillon''': That fella's been at it for as long as anyone could remember, never seemed to age a day. The ship never got any better either... So what are you, some kind of magician? ---- ;(Complete repairing Pequod) :;'''Dillon''' What a great ship;... :'''Dillon''': This ship's huge, isn't it? But, something about it feels familiar. :{{DIcon}} It reminds me of the Fool's Sail... :'''Dillon''': Yes! That's it, it looks like the Fool's Sails used by the Order! :'''Dillon''': I wonder what this ship looked like before. With all the new parts patched on, and its new shape, can it still be called the same ship? :'''Dillon''': Speaking of, do you know how to sail this thing? :{{DIcon}} It's too big, I don't think I could. :{{DIcon}} I know someone who could sail her out of here. :'''Dillon''': Imagine sailing a ship of this size... You'd look mighty impressive out there. :'''Dillon''': Abyssal sea serpants, hell, even a big ol' whale would be a walk in the park. :{{DIcon}} Maybe that's what it was made for in the first place. :{{DIcon}} You can take Cetus the Tidebreaker off that trophy list. :'''Dillon''': Sure, but even though boarding the Fool's Sail isn't exactly something to celebrate... I'd still love to give it a try. Never been anywhere beyond the Stormy Sea myself... ---- ;(Complete the Interlude Quest) :'''Dillon''': Ah, back already? :'''Dillon''': I heard the news. The ship has ended up broke again, right? :'''Dillon''': Ahab has disappeared, and even that Queequeg who's always fixing the ship is nowhere to be found. :'''Dillon''': Funny. Kind of miss him now. {{Dialogue End}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Dillon |zhs = 狄伦 |zht = 狄倫 |ja = ディラン |ko = 딜런 |es = Dillon |fr = Dillon |de = Dillon }} ==Change History== {{Change History|2.1}}
